Walk to [[King's Watch]] and search for Charr.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| complete = [[The Great Northern Wall]] mission
}}

===Objectives===
* Search [[King's Watch]] for [[Charr]].
* See [[Lord Darrin]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Longbow]] [[of Charrslaying]] ([[Half Moon]] skin)
** [[Piercing Dmg]]: 11-18 (Requires 3 [[Marksmanship]])
** Two-handed
** Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 10%)
** Dmg +15% (vs. Charr)

==Walkthrough==
After obtaining the quest from [[Sergeant Brannen]] just outside [[Fort Ranik (outpost)|Fort Ranik]], head to [[King's Watch]] in [[Regent Valley]]. A group of four Charr will be waiting at the marked location, but they do not need to be killed. The quest will update upon reaching the quest marker, and you can map travel back to Fort Ranik for the reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Sergeant Brannen
:''"[[Prince Rurik]] is organizing troops to push the Charr back past the Wall. The beasts have made it all the way back here to [[Regent Valley]], and we're going to clean it out. You can help us by heading southwest to '''King's Watch''' and securing the area around the ruins. When it's secure and cleared of all '''Charr''', report to '''Lord Darrin'''."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll take care of it.
| decline = I'm sorry. I have other things I must do.
| ask = We'll hold this area. You head to '''King's Watch'''. Make sure the Charr don't have control of that ceremonial site.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Lord Darrin
:''"It's a relief to know that King's Watch is secure. Every king of Ascalon, including [[King Adelbern]] himself, was crowned on that location. It would be a shame to see it despoiled further. Now, we must finish what we started. Let's retake the Wall."''

==Notes==
*This quest combines well with [[Cities of Ascalon]] and [[The Red-Cloaked Deserter]] as all three require traveling to King's Watch.
